_README: This directory is the APPEND-ONLY provenance of every raise ever authorized against the merge-lane ratchet baseline (orchestrator/tests/merge_lane_ratchet_baseline.json): ONE FILE PER AUTHORIZATION, named <task-id>-<first 12 hex of the sha256 of the entry as sorted-key compact JSON>.json, so two branches authorizing at once add two different files and never conflict. A recorded entry is never modified, deleted or renamed. It is NOT a permission list: no entry here grants a future raise. A commit's raises are covered only by the entry files THAT COMMIT adds -- per measure and key, the rise may not exceed the sum of their (current - baseline); a new_file_over_ceiling or new_function_over_ceiling row is covered when an added entry names it. An added entry must be ATTRIBUTED: its task_id is the task the branch works on -- the id in task/<id> or carry/<id>, or ending the branch name as -<id> -- or one an earlier commit on the branch since main cites, as its scope (fix(<id>): ...) or as "task <id>", which is how a carrier records the task it lands; and its reason is not blank. Pre-commit (scripts/check_staged_ratchet_raise.py) refuses any other, without reading the task store. Each entry's "measures" block is DERIVED from the measured raises the write gate computed, never hand-written, so it describes the BRANCH COMMIT it accompanied, not a state of main: when the ratchet-baseline merge driver composes two branches' moves of one row, main holds ours + theirs - base, a value no single entry names. There is no timestamp: git carries the date. Written by scripts/merge_lane_metrics.py --write-baseline orchestrator/tests/merge_lane_ratchet_baseline.json --authorize-raise <task-id> --reason "<why>".
